handoff.teamEnable: Ask the customer to choose a team
handoff.title: Agent handoff
handoff.assigneesHint: Leave empty to alert every agent — the first to accept takes the conversation.
handoff.noAgents: No agents with the consult label yet.
handoff.useBusinessHours: Route to agents only during business hours
handoff.noticePlaceholder: Leave blank to use the default wording
handoff.emailWarning: Without an email, off-hours escalations still page agents.
handoff.breakHint: Questions during the break are routed like off hours.
handoff.movedToSettings: Business hours and off-hours routing now live in tenant Settings.
handoff.denyHint: Messages matching any keyword are sent straight to an agent — the AI is not asked. Type/label stamp the created issue.
handoff.slaHint: Drives the board's warning/overdue badges. 1-168h; defaults 24h / 4h.
handoff.denyModeHint: "No answer" hands the thread to a person without replying. "Answer, then hand off" replies from the knowledge base first and still hands it over — the agent is paged either way.
handoff.regionPresetHint: The 63 provinces before July 2025 and the 34 merged units after it, with common spellings. Review, then Save.

handoff.unclaimedTitle: Alert again when nobody takes a conversation
handoff.unclaimedAuto: Automatic (on when assignees, team routing or region routing are set)
handoff.unclaimedHint: A targeted alert is visible only to the agent it is addressed to. When a waiting conversation is still unclaimed after the wait limit (a server setting, 5 minutes by default), a new alert is raised for everyone who may take it and Slack and email get an “UNCLAIMED” message — a few times at most.
handoff.regionModeLabel: When the hotel's own team cannot take it
handoff.regionModePrefer: Ask the hotel's team first, then anyone (default)
handoff.regionModeStrict: Strict — never leave the hotel's region on its own
handoff.regionModePreferHint: Staff of the hotel's region are paged first, then staff with no region, then every agent.
handoff.regionModeStrictHint: Only staff of the hotel's region (and staff with no region) are paged or see the alert. A conversation reaches the other team only after the delay below.
handoff.regionWiden: Widen to the other region after (minutes)
handoff.regionWidenHint: Strict mode only. Leave empty or 0 to never widen: this is the only way a conversation reaches the other team.
handoff.regionContactsHint: Each team's mailbox for off-hours summaries and Slack webhook for alerts. Blank = the shared mailbox and the server's default webhook. Slack webhooks are stored encrypted and never shown again.
handoff.regionSlackSaved: A webhook is saved. Paste a new URL to replace it, or clear the field to remove it.
handoff.teamHoursToggle: This team has its own business hours
handoff.teamHoursOff: Business hours: follows the shared hours
handoff.teamHoursHint: Outside these hours a customer who asks for this team is told to expect an email reply instead of a live agent.
handoff.hotelHint: For hosts that sign the hotel but not its province. Upload a CSV and the signed hotel number decides the region; a hotel name is never used. A province signed in the identify claims always wins over this table.
handoff.hotelFormat: CSV with a header row and two columns: hotel_sn, province (UTF-8; other columns are ignored).

coach.editHint: The agent drafted this. What you save here is what takes effect.

coach.kbRevertHint: Undo from the document's revision history.

answerReuse.title: Answer reuse
answerReuse.desc: Verified past answers (agent replies, high-confidence cited AI answers) are replayed for near-duplicate questions before calling the AI engine. Edit or disable entries here; disable all after a large knowledge update.
answerReuse.saveError: Failed to update the answer-reuse entry.
answerReuse.deleteConfirm: Delete this entry? It will no longer be replayed.
answerReuse.deactivateAllConfirm: Deactivate every stored answer? New questions will always go to the AI engine until entries are re-enabled or re-learned.

regression.title: Regression check
regression.hint: Re-asks the same questions after a config change. Wording changes are not judged, but a question with expected facts gets pass/fail by whether those facts are in the answer, and masks like ▇▇▇ or [PHONE] always fail.
regression.empty: No questions yet. Add one you care about getting right.
regression.addPlaceholder: e.g. How long does delivery take?
regression.sameConfigNotice: Both runs used the same configuration, so every difference below is the model's own variance — not the effect of a change.
regression.bulkPlaceholder:
question<TAB>fact1|fact2<TAB>forbidden (optional)
e.g. How do I pay Go2Joy?	Techcombank|19133261136016
regression.bulkHint: {{count}} lines · up to {{max}} questions. A question with the same text only gets its facts updated.
regression.factsPlaceholder: Expected facts (separate with |; empty = not graded)
regression.toastStarted: Started a run of {{count}} questions. Results appear in the list when it finishes.
regression.bulkGateHint: Optional 5th and 6th columns: audience (guest, partner, receptionist, manager) and expected gate (allow, refuse).

history.toastLoaded: Loaded into the editors. Review it, then save.
history.notePlaceholder: Why this change? (optional, saved to the history)

kbVersion.title: Reference UI version
kbVersion.hint: Name the product version your users run today. Knowledge documents can be stamped with the version they describe (Knowledge › document › UI version). An answer that cites a document of another version gets one fixed sentence, or that document is left out. Versions are labels compared for equality — “v0.12.0”, “V0.12.0” and “0.12.0” are the same, “0.12.0” and “0.12.1” are not — so any numbering works; nothing is ordered. A document with no version is never flagged in answers.
kbVersion.referenceInvalid: Use 1–16 characters: letters, digits and . _ + - (no spaces).
kbVersion.referenceRequired: Enter the current version, or choose “Off”.
kbVersion.onMismatch: When a document is stamped with another version

mode.caveat: Add a note to the answer

modeHint.caveat: The answer is delivered as usual, followed by one fixed sentence (added after moderation, before the contact block).
modeHint.hide: The document is left out of search, so the assistant cannot cite it. Documents with no version stay available.
modeHint.off: Versions are shown in the knowledge list but change nothing in answers.

kbVersion.noticeHint: Blank uses the built-in sentence shown in grey. Keep it to one sentence; it is added only when a cited document is stamped with another version.
kbVersion.retireNote: Changing the version or the mode also retires stored answers, so none is replayed under the old rule.
kbVersion.saveError: Could not save the reference version

guest.managerNoticeHint: Shown to a receptionist who asks about a manager-only topic, together with a "Talk to an agent" button. Blank = the built-in line in that language.
